verdict.rationale: Milvus is repeatedly described as an 'open-source vector database' in its own docs, and its source code is publicly hosted on GitHub (milvus-io/milvus), which the evidence cites directly for code snippets and installation instructions. This confirms the source is readable and publicly available under an open-source model. Missing for 10: explicit license name/badge (e.g., Apache-2.0) in the evidence, and independent third-party confirmation of licensing terms.
